description: This is a utility class for managing date and time operations in Java, including formatting, parsing, conversions between different date/time classes, and timezone adjustments within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UtilDateTime
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for date and time manipulation within the OFBiz framework, including parsing, formatting, timezone conversions, and calculations involving java.util.Date, java.sql.Timestamp, and related classes.

classes.name: ImmutableDate
classes.description: A private static subclass extending Date to provide an immutable, unmodifiable date object.

methods.name: getIntervalInDays
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two Timestamps.

methods.name: addDaysToTimestamp
methods.description: Adds a specified number of days represented by a Double or int to a given Timestamp.

methods.name: formatInterval
methods.description: Formats a time interval into a human-readable string with units like milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, and weeks, localized based on the provided Locale.

methods.name: getDayStart
methods.description: Returns a Timestamp representing the start of the day for a given Timestamp, possibly offset by days.

methods.name: getDayEnd
methods.description: Returns a Timestamp representing the end of the day for a given Timestamp, possibly offset by days.

methods.name: toCalendar
methods.description: Converts a java.util.Date to a Calendar object, considering timezone and locale.

methods.name: toSqlDate
methods.description: Converts date strings or integers into java.sql.Date objects.

methods.name: toSqlTime
methods.description: Converts time strings or integers into java.sql.Time objects.

methods.name: toTimestamp
methods.description: Converts date/time strings or Date objects into java.sql.Timestamp.

methods.name: toDate
methods.description: Converts date/time strings into java.util.Date objects, supporting various formats and individual components.

methods.name: toDateString
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string using specified or default formats.

methods.name: toTimeString
methods.description: Formats a Date or individual time components into a string in HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format.

methods.name: toDateTimeString
methods.description: Creates a combined date and time string from a Date, optionally including seconds.

methods.name: monthBegin
methods.description: Returns a Timestamp for the beginning of the current month.

methods.name: weekNumber
methods.description: Calculates the week number for a given Timestamp, considering timezone and locale.

methods.name: dayNumber
methods.description: Returns the day of the week for a given Timestamp (Sunday=1).

methods.name: getDayNames
methods.description: Provides a list of localized day names for calendar headings.

methods.name: getMonthNames
methods.description: Provides a list of localized month names for calendar headings.

methods.name: toDateFormat
methods.description: Returns a DateFormat object configured for date formatting with locale and timezone.

methods.name: toDateTimeFormat
methods.description: Returns a DateFormat object configured for date and time formatting.

methods.name: toTimeFormat
methods.description: Returns a DateFormat object configured for time formatting.

methods.name: stringToTimeStamp
methods.description: Parses a localized date/time string into a Timestamp, considering timezone and locale.

methods.name: timeStampToString
methods.description: Formats a Timestamp into a localized string with optional custom format, timezone, and locale.

methods.name: getEarliestDate
methods.description: Provides the earliest representable Date in the system (e.g., min Year).

methods.name: getLatestDate
methods.description: Provides the latest representable Date in the system (e.g., max Year).
